remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Not recorded Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive indicates, "Roy and Marie Neuberger Collection." Whitney Archive does not date. Downtown Gallery Archive dates c. 1925 and 1929. Dated 1930 on basis of verso inscription. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as 'Oil on canvas', Neuberger Museum of Art lists it as 'Oil and gouache on canvas'. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Neuberger Museum of Art, 2025)

credit_line: Collection Neuberger Museum of Art, Purchase College SUNY, Gift of Roy R. Neuberger, 1970.02.26
description: Rolling green hills dotted with white and green trees fill the foreground of the composition. Behind the trees, a blue lake glows slightly white at its center, reflecting the moon above. The moon is just visible in a sliver of sky above tall blue and green mountains.
